secrets.name: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase service role (secret) key from your Supabase project dashboard (Project Settings → API → service_role secret). Only needed for the /admin route; the public site works without it.

secrets.name: ADMIN_USERNAME
secrets.description: Username for the /admin login. Defaults to 'admin' if unset.

secrets.name: ADMIN_PASSWORD
secrets.description: Password for the /admin login. Only needed to access the /admin route.

secrets.name: ADMIN_SESSION_SECRET
secrets.description: Secret used to sign admin session cookies. Only needed for the /admin route.
